description: R-SQL-1 SQL-SUB-02: What truth value (projected as a column over LD, whose id is 1, 1, Null) do IN, NOT IN, = ANY, = SOME, > ALL, >= ALL and < ALL give over an empty set (E), an all-Null set (NS), a matching set (R.lid) and a mixed Null set (RX.lid)? One NOT IN case is repeated in WHERE in case the projected form is refused. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
